title: Art school continued
content: The buildings and levels are getting clearer. I’m always running late or forgetting where the class is (typical). There is one male professor who has shown up a few times in previous dreams. I’m suspicious of him, and I in my dream I remember him from before. One building, the mom building of the campus probably, has a cafe type place open sometimes with seating in a big open area. They don’t take Apple Pay and it drives me nuts.
